description:
Found by the fz-kdt.194 cold review (2026-09-03, base ca23b676f) while trying
to verify a claim that AOT executable byte size was unchanged.

TWO FACTS, measured over 23 AOT fixtures:
1. The emitted executable EMBEDS THE COMPILING BINARY`S OWN PATH -- five
   `N_OSO` entries in the string table. So two compilers built from different
   worktrees (a base binary under `.kdt/base` and a head binary) emit
   executables that differ in bytes for a fixture whose canonical form is
   IDENTICAL. Any base-vs-head comparand over executable bytes or size is a
   false mover by construction, and this bit several agents in this arc.
2. AOT output is not byte-reproducible from ONE binary either.

On the path-independent comparand (excluding those entries) 2 of 23 `__text`
sizes moved by +116 and +24 bytes, both on fixtures that were already settled
canon movers and both absorbed by page padding -- i.e. the real signal is tiny
and was buried under the path noise. stdout and exit code md5 ARE identical on
all 23.

WHY IT MATTERS: the arc`s standing comparand is the `--dump backend=` canonical
form (fz-f98.21), which is path-independent and faithful, and that is what
every gate should use. But reviewers reach for executable size as a
cross-check, and today it silently lies. Either make the emitted executable
path-independent (drop or normalise the N_OSO entries) or document that
executable bytes are not a comparand and give the path-independent recipe.

CONCORDANT: fz-kdt.54 (dump native/fnir are {:#?}, non-reproducible across
processes -- the same family: an artifact rendering that is not a stable
comparand); fz-kdt.174 (closed: one binary emitted two different backend
programs cross-session); fz-f98.21 (the canonical form that IS the right
comparand).

REPRODUCER: build the same commit in two worktrees at different paths, AOT-
compile any fixture with each, and diff the executables -- they differ; strip
the five N_OSO string-table entries and they agree except on genuine movers.
title: [BUG] The AOT executable is not byte-reproducible and embeds the compiler build path: 5 N_OSO string-table entries make any executable-size or byte comparand a false mover
